assessments.reasoning: The survey's definition of work in Section 2, Part A (Questions 1 and 2) covers only market-oriented activities, paid services, family businesses, or production for sale or monetary gain. Unpaid domestic and care work is not included in the definition of economic activity. Instead, unpaid domestic and care work is mentioned and classified under non-work categories, such as a reason for not seeking work (Question 6, option 11) or an inactive status (Question 7, option 2).
